Mermaid Roshan · draft graphics audit

Every job, in context

35 activity contexts · 115 phases/pages · 700 fresh diagnostic frames · 777 source images · 9826 texture usages · 167 code-drawn components

All scores are drafting opinions. ≤4.5/5 is a refinement priority. Native captures use Godot 4.7.2 Mobile at two widths; direct state selection and hidden global HUD limit acceptance. Stored draw inputs may be absent from a frame. Nursery v4 remains owner-rejected as too lifelike. Owner, played motion, actual input, device and child acceptance remain open.

Written report · Individual priority queue · Full usage inventory · Capture evidence · Earlier source and planned-contest library · Five completed local motion studies · Fresh reversible replacements · Timed action reviews

Entrance Kitchen

The room and its career cards are part of the job experience. Entrance → costume/job world → persistent result → return must keep location and scale readable. This audit captures the room boundary and direct activity states, not a complete input traversal.

Entrance / return controls · draft 4.3/5

The shell fixtures and central walking lane are coherent; two career portrait cards float high above the appliances.

Refinement: Reuse the existing room/prop family; refine route-card scale, placement and room material at both widths. Verify the real entrance, return, caption and voice seam.

Refinement: Reuse the existing room/prop family; refine route-card scale, placement and room material at both widths. Verify the real entrance, return, caption and voice seam.

Practice Arborist

Identify tree → identify symptom → choose spray → carry → treat → recover. This is the clearest visual causal chain in the audit. Two black-backed distractors and crowded treatment contact weaken an otherwise consistent book/patient sequence. Earlier stale Geologist captions were a capture-harness artifact and are excluded from findings.

Output Party Table

Empty → unstirred batter → stirred batter → six baked tiers → stacked → frosted → five prepared berries → placed berries and candle. Approved stage-art continuity is stronger than the work-phase proxy continuity. The study deliberately adds an inspection layer; the actual receiving-room/lawn traversal remains unverified. Do not report the first discarded hidden-layer capture as a game defect.

The shell brush has a clear single-tool silhouette, broad rainbow bristles and a strong purple contour.

Reuse this brush for local contact; keep bristles visibly touching the material.

D2A-0002 · 4.6/5

The pointing hand is extremely easy to recognize and its warm fill separates from purple scenery.

Verify the fingertip lands on the exact active target and disappears after accepted input.

assets/castle/training/ghost_hand.png

D2A-0003 · 4.7/5

Five separate glazed strawberries read clearly on a restrained tray; the broad coating highlights support the candy finish.

Retain; verify all five become the same five cake toppings, subject to the revised story direction.

assets/chapter2/birthday/chapter2_candied_strawberries_tray.png

D2A-0004 · 4.5/5

Six colored tiers are distinguishable, but the detached trays and similar broad discs weaken the sense of assembling one cake.

Review stacking contact and tier order before drawing anything new.

D2A-0005 · 4.7/5

The unified spiral visibly distinguishes mixed batter from separate rainbow bands.

Retain this state and compare the exact stirring payoff with the unstirred bowl.

Separate rainbow batter bands give a readable before-state while retaining the same bowl identity.
